requirements.title: Data loss at interchange boundaries
requirements.normative_statement: CRS metadata stored in `customData` or proprietary attributes is routinely stripped during USD export/import cycles across different tools.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: No standard for CRS inheritance
requirements.normative_statement: Without a defined inheritance model, every prim in a large scene must redundantly carry CRS metadata, or tools must implement ad-hoc resolution logic.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Precision hazards
requirements.normative_statement: A UTM easting of 481,948 m exceeds the useful range of `float32`, and implementations store it in a `point3f` array anyway, because nothing tells them not to. The result is visible jitter and drift in scenes that look correct on paper.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Multi-CRS composition is undefined
requirements.normative_statement: A cross-state pipeline spans UTM zones 11 and 12, and a regional twin draws on imagery, terrain and vectors that each arrive in their own CRS. Today the only way to put them on one stage is to convert them all first, which is a cost the largest projects cannot pay.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Industry adoption is blocked
requirements.normative_statement: GIS vendors, AECO tool makers, and digital twin platforms cannot fully adopt USD without a standard way to express CRS, because it is a foundational requirement for their workflows.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Minimal disruption
requirements.normative_statement: No changes to existing USD schemas or core APIs. The geospatial schemas are additive and optional.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Extensible
requirements.normative_statement: Third-party CRS libraries (PROJ, GDAL, Esri, Trimble) can supply coordinate operations. The proposal specifies data and observable runtime behavior, including validation and resolved queries; it does not prescribe callable interfaces or a particular implementation architecture.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Interoperable
requirements.normative_statement: The design should facilitate round-trip exchange with glTF (geospatial extension), IFC, CityGML, and OGC 3D Tiles.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Positions, and offsets from them
requirements.normative_statement: Content is placed by a position, orientation and scale with defined meaning in a named CRS, and the content beneath that placement is authored and moved as ordinary scene offsets in scene distances by someone who need know no geodesy.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Offsets along the axes of their position
requirements.normative_statement: Offsets beneath a CRS placement have an orientation and scale discoverable from its authored placement and CRS without resolving into another CRS, and resolution accounts for changes in local axes and scale as well as position.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Position or offset, and the scene says which
requirements.normative_statement: Whether an authored location is a position in a CRS or an offset from its parent can be read from the scene, and a CRS position does not accumulate ancestor xformOps.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: No angle read as a length
requirements.normative_statement: Every coordinate's unit, and the surface its height is measured from, are unambiguous, and no reading of the scene takes an angular coordinate as a scene distance.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: One axis mapping
requirements.normative_statement: The semantic component order of a CRS position is fixed by this proposal rather than by the CRS's declared storage order, with easting, northing and up occupying the first, second and third components respectively, and its representation in a scene frame follows the common convention specified under requirement 14.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Scene conventions stay the scene's

verification_gaps: Q9 geographic scene geometry, frames and bounds remains a design question; geographic coordinate queries remain supported.
Continuous nonlinear extent and between-sample trajectory guarantees are unsupported, with visible failure rather than an inferred certificate.
C++ validation is not a second independent WKT normalizer. External format decoding is shared; Python and C++ share PROJ, while OV reuses the Python placement algorithm.
Hydra consumes an ordinary resolved export; no live geospatial scene-index filter or physics integration is claimed.
External adapters cover selected CF, single-IFD GeoTIFF and RFC 7946 domains, not all coordinate forms in those standards.
Export preserves tested geometry/sample associations but materializes instances; authored shading-normal and general material/primvar semantics are not certified.

implementation_gaps.finding: Retained earlier placement implementations expect a crs:binding relationship, while the shared proposal uses reference-based binding. A counterexample tests this incompatibility. Current discovery readers follow composed applied binding and crs:wkt instead.

investigation.finding: I substituted my candidate for shared-proposal authority.
investigation.evidence: 35b80973c froze candidate answers while runtime-open-decisions.md explicitly said group decisions were still needed. PLAN.md allowed completing experimental answers.
investigation.consequence: A pre-code freeze prevented retrofitting but did not prove independent derivability from the proposal.

investigation.finding: I audited code against its candidate more thoroughly than the candidate against the actual proposal.
investigation.evidence: The input selection excluded legacy callable/reset/translate sketches, although they remained in the shared proposal.
investigation.consequence: The experiment bypassed contradictions instead of first producing a coherent proposal.

investigation.finding: I did not make known gaps stop completion.
investigation.evidence: aba7900213 AUDIT.md explicitly retained the R24 gap. c1c3506be README nevertheless opened with complete experimental run and the deck led with a render.
investigation.consequence: Execution completion became the headline and unresolved semantic dependencies became qualifications.

investigation.finding: The trace and tests did not check every required result.
investigation.evidence: The original R7 trace incorrectly pointed to measurement association; the runner had no bounds or relative-frame result domains and required explicit output. Export tests used only data:-named fixture properties.
investigation.consequence: Passing self-selected tests hid missing coverage and fixture-specific shortcuts.

investigation.finding: I did not distinguish decision freedom from an unspecified contract.
investigation.evidence: The candidate prescribed field types, dimensionality, frame approximations and export metadata without those choices being settled in the shared model.
investigation.consequence: Permission to explore labeled alternatives became a path to one executable candidate, rather than a blocking proposal-gap report.

proposal_quality.process_correction: Read the entire pinned proposal. Cite existing answers before identifying the smallest missing authored fact or observable meaning. A chosen internal algorithm or an absent test is not a new proposal gap. Stop the dependent derivation. Never certify a private experimental model as shared-proposal authority.
stopping_policy: At each required semantic choice, cite its exact proposal clause or explicit normative reference.
If that source is missing or conflicting, stop the dependent derivation and immediately report the gap, affected requirement and proposed alternatives.
Continue only independent work or explicitly authorized labeled experiments. Keep their assumptions separate from proposal conformance.
Review any proposed specification repair against requirements and data ownership. Do not approve it because the implementation already uses it.
A semantic change requires a new pinned specification before affected code/tests and invalidates affected evidence.
A missing required test is unfinished verification, not an open design question.
The default build gate stops while specification gaps remain. An explicit experimental invocation records proposal_ready=false and requirements_build_complete=false.
postimplementation_audit_required: Map every authored field to a source property contract.
Separate internal algorithms from authored facts and new normative choices.
Audit every advertised consumer path against actual sink readback.
Record unsupported combinations and absent tests instead of declaring whole-requirement conformance.
Require source hashes and immutable receipts before delivery.

limitations: New working-chart/pivot/reset and external association semantics are local proposals, not group agreement.
No continuous affine/surface extent certificate or between-sample trajectory guarantee is claimed. Exact queried vertices and polygonal readback do not certify those domains.
Python and C++ share PROJ; OV reuses the Python algorithm and external dataset decoding is shared. Pipeline equivalence is separately reported.
Hydra consumes a resolved ordinary-USD export from C++ results. This is not a live geospatial scene-index filter. OV runtime geometry writeback is verified; no OV render is claimed.
Export materializes native instances and recomputes geometric normals. Preservation of instancing and authored shading-normal semantics is not claimed.
External original climate metadata is incomplete and original railway heights remain uninterpreted; explicit horizontal illustrative associations preserve their useful workflows.
Geographic scene frames/bounds remain Q9. Coordinate epochs remain deferred.

Independently CRS-bound point-instancer prototypes remain G11. Cartesian local-frame derivatives are numerical estimates with a convergence residual, not an extent certificate. Physics integration has no evidence in this run. No complete functional-requirement conformance is claimed.

verification_gaps: Q9 geographic scene geometry, frames and bounds remains a design question; geographic coordinate queries remain supported.
Continuous nonlinear extent and between-sample trajectory guarantees are unsupported, with visible failure rather than an inferred certificate.
C++ validation is not a second independent WKT normalizer. External format decoding is shared; Python and C++ share PROJ, while OV reuses the Python placement algorithm.
Hydra consumes an ordinary resolved export; no live geospatial scene-index filter or physics integration is claimed.
External adapters cover selected CF, single-IFD GeoTIFF and RFC 7946 domains, not all coordinate forms in those standards.
Export preserves tested geometry/sample associations but materializes instances; authored shading-normal and general material/primvar semantics are not certified.

execution_authority: Explicitly authorized local run using emailed candidate leans; no group agreement or whole-proposal conformance asserted

delivery_provenance.adaptation: Local path prefixes made portable. Missing-value NaN serializes as JSON null with the original mask retained. Executed source hashes and finite numerical results retained.
